run_exit_test: run the gRPC exit test suite to verify clean server and client shutdown on interpreter exit
test_running_server: test that a running gRPC server exits cleanly when the Python interpreter shuts down
test_unstarted_server: test that an unstarted gRPC server exits cleanly without hanging on interpreter shutdown
test_in_flight_unary_unary_call: test clean exit of a gRPC server while a unary-unary RPC call is in flight
test_poll_connectivity: test clean exit of a gRPC client polling channel connectivity on interpreter shutdown
